description: Calculate pay from approved time; fund direct deposit and pay cards; tax withholding; pay on Friday
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 450 associates expect pay every Friday (about $270K); a missed payday drives associates to competitors within days and triggers wage complaints; payroll is processed Thursday so 48 h is the outer limit
manual_workaround: Off-cycle manual payroll from the prior week's register with adjustments; pay card funding through the vendor's support line
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04 integration service; SYS-11
dependent_third_parties: Payroll vendor; payroll vendor's bank; ISP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Payroll Manager; 3 Payroll Specialists; Controller; HQ

description: Associates clock in on the mobile app; client supervisors approve timesheets in the client portal by Monday noon
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cannot run without approved time; clients approve Monday for Thursday processing; punches lost after 4 h are hard to reconstruct
manual_workaround: Paper timesheets signed by client supervisors and scanned or faxed to the branch
dependent_systems: SYS-06; SYS-01 client portal; SYS-04 integration service

business_process: Associate onboarding (Form I-9, E-Verify, background checks, tax and bank forms)
description: Complete Form I-9 Sections 1-2, create the E-Verify case, order the consumer report, collect W-4 and direct deposit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Form I-9 Section 2 and the E-Verify case are due within 3 business days of hire (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii); MOU Art. II.A.8); new starts stop if onboarding stops; about 40 hires a week
manual_workaround: Paper Form I-9 packets at each branch; E-Verify website used directly; screening provider portal used directly; document E-Verify outages (Fla. Stat. 448.095(2)(c))
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; DHS E-Verify; screening provider

description: Take job orders and assign associates to next-day shifts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Unfilled shifts cost about $19K gross margin per business day and clients switch vendors after missed shifts
manual_workaround: Phone and spreadsheet dispatch from the last assignment export; branch phone trees

description: Text and email associates about shifts, closures, and pay
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Associates must learn of site closures (for example, hurricanes) before traveling
manual_workaround: Recruiters call from company smartphones using printed contact lists

description: Post jobs, receive applications, AI ranking, interviews, offers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A few days' delay slows fills; walk-in applicants can be handled on paper
manual_workaround: Paper applications at branches; job boards' own inboxes
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; AI vendor; job boards

description: Produce Forms I-9 and audit trails on 3 business days' notice; answer consumer report disputes; E-Verify case follow-up
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inspection notice gives 3 business days (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(ii)); records must stay available and unaltered
manual_workaround: Request an extension from the inspecting agency; produce ATS records first and archive records later
dependent_systems: SYS-01 I-9 module; SYS-04 document archive; SYS-04 backup vault

description: Weekly invoices from approved time; ACH and check receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $390K billed per week; a week's delay strains cash but is recoverable with the credit line
manual_workaround: Invoice from payroll register exports; delay one cycle

description: Biweekly payroll for 60 internal staff; hiring and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly schedule allows a short delay
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the vendor
